chats.empty.title: No chats yet
chats.empty.body: Chats you start in the Code tab of Claude Desktop show up here.
chats.empty.list_body: Copy or move chats here from another list.
chats.nomatch.title: No chat matches “{query}”
chats.nomatch.body: Press esc to clear the search.
chats.lost.empty.title: No lost chats
chats.lost.empty.body: Every chat on disk is in a chat list.
chats.lost.hidden.one: {n} older part of a chat you already have is left out
chats.lost.hidden.other: {n} older parts of chats you already have are left out
chats.copy.body: The newest copy wins: a chat that is newer in {to} is left as it is. You can undo it in Activity.
chats.move.body: The chats leave {from} once {to} has them. The newest copy wins, and you can undo it in Activity.
chats.copy.nothing: “{to}” already has these chats, as new or newer.
chats.mixed.title: Pick chats from one list
chats.mixed.body: The selected chats come from {n} lists. Copy and move take chats from one list at a time: open that list, or select chats of one list only.
chats.no_target.title: No other chat list
chats.no_target.body: Claude Desktop makes a chat list the first time you use its Code tab with an account.
chats.no_list.title: No chat list yet
chats.rescue.body: Each gets a card in {to}, so Claude Desktop shows it again. You can undo it in Activity.
chats.export.body: The files are saved in your Downloads folder.
